scripts.build:linux: npm run build:linux:x64 && npm run build:linux:arm64 && npm run build:linux:armv7l
scripts.build:linux:x64: npx --yes tsx ./build/setup-plugins.ts --platform=linux --arch=x64 && cd headlamp && make app-build && cd app && npm run package -- --linux --x64
scripts.build:linux:arm64: npx --yes tsx ./build/setup-plugins.ts --platform=linux --arch=arm64 && cd headlamp && make app-build && cd app && npm run package -- --linux AppImage tar.gz --arm64
scripts.build:linux:armv7l: npx --yes tsx ./build/setup-plugins.ts --platform=linux --arch=armv7l && cd headlamp && make app-build && cd app && npm run package -- --linux AppImage tar.gz --armv7l
scripts.build:mac: npm run plugin:setup && cd headlamp && make app-mac
scripts.build:win: npm run build:win:x64 && npm run build:win:arm64
scripts.build:win:x64: npx --yes tsx ./build/setup-plugins.ts --platform=win32 --arch=x64 && cd headlamp && make app-win-x64
scripts.build:win:arm64: npx --yes tsx ./build/setup-plugins.ts --platform=win32 --arch=arm64 && cd headlamp && make app-win-arm64
scripts.build:unpacked: npm run plugin:setup && cd headlamp && make app-build
scripts.build:unpacked:linux: npm run plugin:setup && cd headlamp && make app-build
scripts.build:unpacked:mac: npm run plugin:setup && cd headlamp && make app-build
scripts.build:unpacked:win: npm run plugin:setup && cd headlamp && make app-build
scripts.headlamp:install: cd headlamp/frontend && npm install && cd ../app && npm install
scripts.headlamp:build: cd headlamp && make backend && make frontend
scripts.install:all: npm run headlamp:install && npm run plugin:install && npm run ai-assistant:install
scripts.build:all: npm run headlamp:build && npm run plugin:build && npm run ai-assistant:build
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "PLUGIN,AI-ASSISTANT,BACKEND,FRONTEND,APP" -c "cyan,blue,green,yellow,magenta" "npm run plugin:start" "npm run ai-assistant:start" "cd headlamp && make run-backend" "cd headlamp && make run-frontend" "cd headlamp && make run-only-app"
